Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the comparative logic. Despite correctly identifying the directors’ birth years (Victor Schertzinger: 1888; Giorgi Shengelaia: 1937), they concluded that Shengelaia (born later) was older and declared “Melodies of Vera Quarter” as the answer. The correct reasoning is that an earlier birth year indicates an older director, so “Road to Singapore” should have been selected.
